text: Songgrid · 宋律是一款面向 DSH 网页端的主题插件，以宣纸暖白和汝窑天青呈现浅色界面，并以夜墨蓝黑和亮天青呈现深色界面。它通过覆盖主题设计令牌并在“设置 → 通用”加入主题选择器，让用户选择宣纸、夜墨或跟随系统。主题还提供中文宋体排版、山水背景、分层间距与图标样式，以及用于引用块的编辑强调色。主题选择会保存在浏览器本地，并尝试通过 DSH 设置命名空间同步；无需 API 密钥。

Songgrid is a DSH web theme with rice-paper light and night-ink dark palettes. Settings offers both variants or system appearance. It adds Chinese Song-serif typography, landscape imagery, spacing and icon styles, and a blockquote accent. Choices are saved locally and may sync through DSH settings.

I want a rice-paper light theme for the DSH web interface.

Songgrid 的功能「浅色与深色配色」：提供宣纸暖白的 Xuanzhi 和夜墨蓝黑的 Yemo 两套色彩令牌，并分别适配明暗模式。 通过启用主题自动应用。
Songgrid 的功能「主题选择器」：在设置的通用项目中加入选择行，支持选择宣纸、夜墨或跟随系统。 通过启用主题自动应用。
Songgrid 的功能「中文宋体排版」：定义 Noto Serif SC 字体，并在主题启用时应用于正文和 Markdown 文本。 通过启用主题自动应用。
Songgrid 的功能「界面视觉样式」：注入结构尺度、Lucide 图标、语义强调和山水背景等 CSS 层。 通过启用主题自动应用。
Songgrid 使用 Noto Serif SC 中文字体，浏览器会从 registry.npmmirror.com 加载字体文件；字体不可用时 CSS 提供本机字体回退。
想给 DSH 聊天窗口加一套中式配色和传统字体。
I need a custom appearance for my DSH web client that follows my OS theme.

dsh-theme-songgrid README · Songgrid · 宋律：> The two variants, captured live (the sidebar is the [Eight Standing Seats](https://github.com/yefengliu1/dsh-agent-grid) board). *Card areas are redacted.*

dsh-theme-songgrid README · Why "Songgrid"：The warm white of rice paper, the celadon of Ru ware, the warning red of cinnabar — disciplined by Swiss International Style: a 4pt spacing scale, 2/4px radii, and type sizes locked to line heights.

This is not ancient styling pasted onto a UI. Every traditional colour is **placed on the functional role it can actually hold**.

dsh-theme-songgrid README · Two accents, two jobs：The one decision in this theme that looks like a duplicate but must not be collapsed:

| Role | Colour | Contrast (on paper) | Where it lands |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- |
| **Functional** · Ru celadon | `#3A7284`  | **4.91 : 1** ✓ AA | buttons · focus ring · selection · links |
| **Editorial** · kiln copper | `#9A6B50`  | 4.19 : 1 | blockquotes · markers |

dsh-theme-songgrid README · Two accents, two jobs：> Celadon passes WCAG AA, so it can carry "can I click this / is this selected". Kiln copper does not pass AA for body text, so it only carries "is this worth a second look".
> Their hues sit **174°** apart — they were never two candidates for one role.

dsh-theme-songgrid README · Two variants：| Variant | id | Character |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Xuanzhi** (rice paper) | `song-grid-xuanzhi` | warm paper white × Ru celadon × cinnabar |
| **Yemo** (night ink) | `song-grid-yemo` | cool blue-black × brightened celadon |
| **Follow system** | `system` | switches with the host |

dsh-theme-songgrid README · Typography：- **Chinese** runs on a Song serif (`Noto Serif SC`); **Latin** stays sans-serif — each script gets its own face, never mixed
- Sizes are defined in pairs with their line heights (body / secondary / caption)
- Emphasis comes from **colour roles** (celadon vs. kiln copper), not from stacking bolds

dsh-theme-songgrid README · Structure layers：Three layers; two of them are **orthogonal to colour** — future palette work never touches them:

| Layer | Contents | Colour |
| --- | --- | :---: |
| `STRUCTURE_CSS` | spacing scale (4pt grid + semantic aliases) · 2/4px radii · 4 line-height steps · 5 motion durations + 3 curves · focus ring · icon sizes | no |
| `ICON_CSS` | 46 Lucide mask icons, following `currentColor` | no |
| `SEMANTIC_CSS` | accent role split (`--sg-accent-functional` / `--sg-accent-editorial`) | yes |

dsh-theme-songgrid README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-theme-songgrid
```

Then **refresh the page** and pick 「宋律 · 宣纸」/「宋律 · 夜墨」/ follow-system under **Settings → General → Theme**. The choice persists in the `song-grid-theme` settings namespace (the host plugin **entry id**).

dsh-theme-songgrid README · Install：> **The entry URL decides whether the choice survives across browsers.** The DSH client only writes settings back to the host when the page hostname is `localhost` / `::1` / `127.x` (`isLoopbackHostname` in `dsh-client-connection`). Opened through `dsh.localhost`, a LAN name or a reverse-proxy domain, the whole settings surface degrades to in-page `memory` — which looks like "I picked the theme, refreshed, and it was gone", and it affects the official theme preference, locale and notification settings just the same. To have the choice remembered across browsers/machines, open `http://localhost:8080/` (or `http://127.0.0.1:3080/?token=…`). Per-browser remembering works on any entry (the plugin keeps its own localStorage mirror).

dsh-theme-songgrid README · Compatibility：- Requires **DSH ≥ 0.2.0-rc.2** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh`); verified on 0.2.0-rc.2 — on 0.1.5-rc.2 install `dsh-theme-songgrid@0.1.0`
- Implemented purely by overriding host design tokens — **no host source is patched**, no raw values
- Not affiliated with DeepSeek

dsh-theme-songgrid README · Porting notes (0.1.5-rc.2 → 0.2.0-rc.2)：- `settingsScope` was removed: the theme preference scope is now `ctx.configForms.get("songgrid")` (the snapshot is still `{ status, value }`)
- The built `lib/client.js` must register under the **package name** in `__ModuleLoader__.load({ id })` — rebuild the bundle after any rename, or the boot aborts with `duplicate factory registration`

dsh-theme-songgrid README · Development：```bash
lib/index.js     host half: registers the songgrid settings namespace
lib/client.js    browser half: theme tokens + three CSS layers + theme picker
assets/          landscape backgrounds (ink / ink-night / celadon)
```

dsh-theme-songgrid README · Development：- **Structure layer**: tokens live in `:root`; add a step there. New styles take `var(--sg-gap-*)` / `var(--sg-radius-*)` — never raw values - **Icons**: ``, 46 glyphs in `ICON_CSS`; sizes via `.sm` / `.lg` / `.xl` or `--sg-icon-size` - **More editorial emphasis**: `--sg-accent-editorial` already exists in `SEMANTIC_CSS`; add selectors — the only rule is **never on an interactive control**, that slot belongs to the functional accent
